template: Create a new throwaway ticket titled '{{v3}}' with a customer, but do NOT add any parts to it. Then open its detail page and attempt to set its status to {{v2}} (Mark {{v2}} action). If the app refuses, report the exact error/validation message verbatim. Then, based on that message, discover what precondition the app enforces for the {{v2}} status (e.g. add a part or whatever it demands) and satisfy it so the probe ticket reaches {{v2}}, reporting what specifically was required. Finally archive the probe ticket so it is not left active, and confirm it shows as archived. Report: the exact error text you saw, what you had to do to satisfy it, and the probe ticket's final archived state.

reportTemplate.summary: Created probe ticket RD-1016 ('{{v3}}', customer 'Probe Customer Ltd') with no parts and clicked "Mark {{v2}}" on its detail page. The app refused with the verbatim error: "Ticket is not ready / A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked {{v2}}", and the status stayed Draft. The required precondition is therefore at least one part, so I added a single part ('{{v3}} Part', cost 50, markup 20, qty 1, supplier Bench Supply Co → price $60.00), waited for the parts table to refresh, and Mark {{v2}} then succeeded (status Draft → {{v2}}). I then archived the ticket: the detail page shows "{{v2}}" + "Archived" with an "Unarchive ticket" button, and with "Show archived" ticked the tickets list shows RD-1016 with the Archived marker, Status {{v2}}, 1 part.

values.exact_error_text:
Ticket is not ready

A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked {{v2}}
values.precondition_required: at least one part on the ticket
values.fix_applied: added part '{{v3}} Part' (cost 50, markup 20, qty 1, supplier Bench Supply Co → price $60.00)
values.final_archived_state: Archived (status {{v2}}; detail page shows 'Unarchive ticket' button)
